samples.question: This picture contains exactly three small panels, one high on the canvas, one near the middle and one low down, each shifted to the left or the right side, with wide empty background and a few small solid clutter marks between them. Each panel is a wide, thin rectangle with a solid dark border enclosing three rows of nine equal square cells, and each cell is either dark (the same tone as the border) or pale (the same tone as the panel's background). The scattered solid clutter marks have no border and no cells and are not panels. Carry out this operation. Number the panels 1, 2 and 3 by their top edges, highest first. Then rebuild a nine-row, nine-column grid by dealing the panels' rows back together in rotation: rebuilt row 1 is panel 1's first row, row 2 is panel 2's first row, row 3 is panel 3's first row, row 4 is panel 1's second row, row 5 is panel 2's second row, row 6 is panel 3's second row, row 7 is panel 1's third row, row 8 is panel 2's third row, and row 9 is panel 3's third row. Keep the columns as drawn. The dark cells of the rebuilt nine-by-nine grid form exactly one figure. Every figure has the same two full-height posts, its leftmost column and its rightmost column, plus three rungs on rebuilt rows 2, 4 and 6. Each rung is four cells long and is either a left rung, filling columns 2 to 5, or a right rung, filling columns 5 to 8. 'ladder' has all three rungs on the left. 'top_hook' has the row 2 rung on the right and the other two on the left. 'mid_hook' has the row 4 rung on the right and the other two on the left. 'foot_hook' has the row 6 rung on the right and the other two on the left. Every figure inks exactly thirty cells in total and exactly ten cells inside every panel, so no count of dark cells, and no panel size, side or position, distinguishes the figures. Each of the three rungs is carried by a different panel, so no single panel and no pair of panels settles the answer, and reading the panels stacked where they lie, without the deal, matches no figure at all. Which figure do the dark cells form? Answer with exactly one of: ladder, top_hook, mid_hook, foot_hook.
